Encode Quasi-Identifiers into a Hardened PPRL Bloom Filter

Source: R/pprl-bloom.R
pprl_encode_bloom.Rd

Encodes patient quasi-identifiers into character q-grams hashed via keyed HMAC-SHA256 double-hashing into an m-bit Bloom filter, with optional randomized response bit-flipping (flip_prob) and constant-weight balanced padding (balanced = TRUE) to resist frequency cryptanalysis.

Usage

pprl_encode_bloom(
  record,
  secret_key,
  m = 1024L,
  k = 15L,
  q = 2L,
  flip_prob = 0,
  balanced = TRUE
)

Arguments

record

Named list (or 1-row data.frame) of quasi-identifiers.

secret_key

Shared consortium HMAC-SHA256 linkage key.

m

Base Bloom filter length in bits (default 1024L).

k

Number of hash functions per q-gram (default 15L).

q

Character q-gram width (default 2L).

flip_prob

Randomized response bit-flipping probability in [0, 0.5) (default 0.0).

balanced

Logical; if TRUE, concatenates bits and 1L - bits so Hamming weight is strictly m (default TRUE).

Value

An object of class "dicomtk_fl_bloom".
